title: Delta — three lockups
question: Same data as now: Δ, live signed time, center-zero bar, BEST, LAST. Green is faster. Pick one to build, or say what still feels off.

options.label: Lockup
options.thesis: The signed time is the graphic. Bar and lap times stay quiet underneath.
options.viewport: One short plaque: Δ left, huge -0.840, thin center-zero bar, BEST and LAST as captions.
options.risk: The bar may feel too thin if you still want analog magnitude at a glance.

options.label: Needle
options.thesis: A sliding caret on the scale. The number rides with it, like a telemetry needle.
options.viewport: Δ hardware left. -0.840 sits over a green caret left of center. BEST and LAST cap the scale.
options.risk: At small deltas the caret sits near zero and can look like the old pip.

options.label: Strip
options.thesis: Same three-column TV bug as Sectors: BEST and LAST as flanks, live delta as the hero.
options.viewport: BEST | live Δ and bar with orange underline | LAST. Center column is ~56%.
options.risk: Reads as a sibling of Sectors; some riders want a single tight strip, not a board.
